content.text: Select a platform that offers flexibility and shareability. Google Slides and PowerPoint work beautifully for presentation-style boards, while design tools like Figma offer more creative freedom for layering and arrangement.

content.text: Balance large focal images that capture attention with smaller supporting visuals that add detail and depth. Your hero images should communicate the primary aesthetic direction immediately.

Mix literal and abstract: Balance obvious references with evocative imagery that captures feeling rather than specific objects
Organize thoughtfully: Sort assets by theme, color family, or project phase to maintain clarity
Consider emotional impact: Each image should contribute to the overall mood you're creating
Avoid visual clutter: Quality over quantity—every element should earn its place
